OP:|.Definition: The bitwise OR operator ({c:keyword}|{/c}) compares the bits of two values and produces a 1 in each position where either bit is 1.

OP:~.Definition: The bitwise complement operator ({c:keyword}~{/c}) flips all the bits of a value. Zeros become ones and ones become zeros.

OP:>>>.Definition: The {c:keyword}>>>{/c} unsigned right shift operator moves the bits of a value to the right by the specified number of positions without preserving the sign bit.
